title: glab mr merge code/* lets a runner merge another item's merge request, or one in another project with -R
goal: Merging a code/<id> request goes through one command that checks it, backlog.py merge ID (in bl_land.py): it merges only code/ID of the item it is given, on the integration remote's own project, refusing another id or project, and when KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER is set only an item of the runner's own sprint; .claude/settings.json drops the glab mr merge allow for it, and the kb-sprint skill's run step and selfcheck's SKILL_COMMANDS name it; planted-failure tests cover another id, another project and another sprint (tests named merge_only_own_code_branch); found by the SP-zihqagoi re-review

run: import json,sys;a=json.load(open('.claude/settings.json'))['permissions']['allow'];sys.exit(1 if 'Bash(glab mr merge code/*)' in a else 0)

repro_reason: a permission decision is made by Claude Code at tool-call time; the repro reads the allow list, the check plants the merges
